text_block_list.text:
/*Classic Triple Crown unachieved. 
However, changes are present.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
The goals for the Senior Year were 
finalized: the Tenno Sho (Spring) and the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
It is likely that the Senior Year results 
originally indicated by 'Parcae' will also 
undergo changes. Recalculation of the 
theoretical values is mandatory.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Japan Cup. Parcae 
projects a crushing defeat.
